$comment: Which desktop e2e files a change reaches (TYTO-309). Read by e2e-select.mjs; guarded by desktop-e2e-map.test.mjs.
paths: globs over the repository (* within a segment, ** across, {a,b} alternatives). e2e: file names under apps/desktop/e2e, or "all".
A changed path in the desktop scope that no entry covers runs everything, so a missing entry costs minutes, never a skipped file.
The selector is a local tool: CI runs the whole suite on every push, so an "all" entry reaches nothing locally and is only named in the summary.
